securityHeaders.name: x-api-key
securityHeaders.description: Your API key **ID only** — the part before the dot, e.g. `ak_live_abc123`. Never send the secret.

securityHeaders.name: x-timestamp
securityHeaders.description: Current Unix timestamp in **milliseconds**. Requests older than 5 minutes are rejected.

securityHeaders.name: x-signature
securityHeaders.description: `HMAC-SHA256(timestamp + method + path + body, SHA256(secret))` as lowercase hex. See [Authentication](/api/v1/authentication).

endpoints.title: Create withdrawal
endpoints.description:
Bundles all currently unsettled `PAID` payments into a settlement request and submits it for payout.

Only one active (`PENDING` or `APPROVED`) request is allowed per merchant per day. If the net amount is below the platform's auto-approval threshold the request is approved immediately and the transfer starts; otherwise it stays `PENDING` until a CeyPay admin reviews it.

Requests created via the API record the `apiKeyId` that made them — `requestedBy` will be `null` and `requesterName` will be `"API"`.

**Rate limit:** 10 requests/minute.

responses.description: Withdrawal request created
No unsettled payments, amount below the minimum withdrawal threshold, or a request already exists for today.
Invalid API key, signature, or timestamp outside the valid window.
Merchant account is inactive or not approved.
Rate limit exceeded. Check the `X-RateLimit-Reset` header for when the window resets.
